notes: Rates are for the target premium with the guarantee to age 95. A longer guarantee costs more.

Every estimate also reports the required no-lapse premium: the least that keeps the guarantee to the chosen age if paid on time. Paying less, or paying late without the no-lapse guarantee rider, can end the guarantee even while there is cash value.
Cash value depends on the declared interest rate and is not projected here.

gender.description: Used to apply the gender factor. Taken from the customer's profile; if it is missing (for example a new prospect), ask the advisor.

smoker.description: Whether the person smokes or has used tobacco in the last 12 months.

death_benefit_option.description: option_a is a level face amount; option_b is face amount plus cash value.

nlg_to_age.description: The age to which the death benefit is guaranteed if the required premium is paid on time. 121 is lifetime.

premium_level.description: Minimum is the required no-lapse premium (the least that keeps the guarantee), target is the standard premium, overfund builds cash value faster.

rider_wp.description: Waiver of premium: the monthly deduction is waived if the insured becomes totally disabled.

rider_adb.description: Accidental death benefit: an extra death benefit if death is caused by an accident.

rider_ltc.description: Long-term care / chronic illness: part of the death benefit can be taken early for qualifying care or a terminal diagnosis.

rider_gpo.description: Guaranteed purchase option: buy more cover at set future dates without new medical evidence.

rider_nlgr.description: No-lapse guarantee rider: a late or missed premium can be caught up within 12 months without losing the guarantee.

rider_olp.description: Overloan protection: stops the policy lapsing when policy loans grow larger than the cash value.

premium_frequency.description: How often the premium is paid. Paying more often adds a small instalment loading.

base.label: Annual rate per $1,000 of cover, male non-smoker, at the reference choices

reference.label: Required no-lapse premium
reference.note: The least you can pay each year and still keep the guarantee to the chosen age, if paid on time.
